desc: Read N, A, B from input. Identify fully-known positions (both A_i, B_i ≠ -1), A-only known, B-only known, and both-unknown.
Collect sums of all fully-known positions. If more than one distinct sum exists, output "No".
If a common sum S exists, verify S ≥ every known A value and every known B value. If any violation, output "No"; otherwise output "Yes".
If no fully-known positions exist, output "Yes" (we can freely choose S = max of all known values, or 0).
Wrap logic in a `solve()` function, read from stdin, write to stdout, and test edge cases (all unknowns, mixed cases, contradictory sums).
Implement solve() in Python and verify against the three sample inputs.
